description: Structure family (crates/twig-fuzz/src/generators/structure.rs): Hand-written probes written next to the generator, recorded with the oracle (all match, so every vector must keep replaying identically; recorded with "isolation": "process"). guard (two-word tests, missing names, extra `else`/`elseif`, nested guards, what the dropped branch defines: macros, blocks, imports, extends, use), tags at the root of child templates (guard, types, deprecated, do, flush, with, apply around blocks), types syntax errors and accepted forms, deprecated options and message formats, do with assignments and destructuring, flush inside captures, with (`only`, lists, numeric keys, non-mappings), apply chains, documentation comments, macros below the template root.
